failure_mode: The system gives an affirmative answer that the user did not give.
cause: Speech is misheard. A person who is not the user speaks at a device of the user. A recording plays.
effect: An action that needs the authorization of the user occurs and no person answered for it. REQ-PL-013 names actions that no person can reverse.
detection: The record of the action names an answer that the user does not recognise.

failure_mode: The user confirms an action other than the action that the unit of work states.
cause: The agent that speaks the question states the action in its own words, which DEC-104 permits.
effect: The user approves an action that the user did not mean.
detection: The user finds it when the effect of the action is seen.

failure_mode: The system gives that the user received a message when the user did not receive it.
cause: A service accepts a message and the user never sees it.
effect: An agent assumes that the user knows, and acts on that.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong assumption back.

failure_mode: The system accepts an exchange from a person who is not the user.
cause: An identification is compromised. A client is left open.
effect: Life state is disclosed. Work is raised in the name of the user.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces work that the user did not raise.

failure_mode: The system gives an answer to a unit of work other than the unit that the user answered.
cause: Two units wait for the user at one time.
effect: An action is approved that the user did not approve.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces the wrong action back.

failure_mode: The system does not return a spoken turn fast enough for speech.
cause: A turn reads too much before it answers.
effect: The user stops the use of speech and uses text. The user can see that the spoken turn failed.

failure_mode: The platform delivers more messages than the user accepts.
cause: A declared condition or an agent starts contact too often.
effect: The user stops the use of the system.

failure_mode: The system does not write an exchange to life state.
cause: A write fails at the end of an exchange.
effect: What an agent could derive from the exchange is lost.

failure_mode: The system does not present a unit of work that waits for the user.
cause: A client does not show it. A later client does not show it.
effect: The work that waits on the answer stops (REQ-PL-025).
detection: A person finds it if the person looks at the work that waits.

failure_mode: An exchange does not continue in a second client.
cause: The state of the exchange is held in the first client.
effect: The user states again what the user already said, and the answer is less useful until the user does.

failure_mode: The system attaches the user to an agent other than the agent that the user chose.
effect: An agent with a different position answers.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks.
